taxon_term.notes: NCBI species identity verified under the current name Faecalibacterium duncaniae; the source notes that this strain was previously named Faecalibacterium prausnitzii.
NCBI species identity verified by exact Taxonomy search; GTDB R232 splits the NCBI species across six species clusters, with no majority cluster.

stored_curation_events.changes: Addressed CI issue #959 by grounding Akkermansia muciniphila, Bacteroides caccae, Ruminococcus torques, and Blautia hydrogenotrophica with manual GTDB R232 pins; marking Desulfovibrio piger as an ambiguous R232 split; and retaining Faecalibacterium duncaniae as unresolved because R232 did not resolve the current NCBI species to a majority GTDB cluster.
